problem.title: The treatment plan is ready. <highlight>The budget is not always.</highlight>
problem.text: When patient contributions rise, recommended services may be postponed, reduced or not started at all. Healio helps patients understand which reimbursement and bonus options may be available to them – without influencing the practice's medical decision.

budget.title: The <highlight>Healio health budget</highlight>
budget.subtitle: Depending on their personal situation, patients may be able to combine health insurer bonuses with supplementary insurance benefits. Healio checks eligibility individually and explains which components can actually be used.
budget.totalDesc: over two years from potential health insurer bonuses and tariff benefits

budget.footnote: The actual amount and availability depend, among other things, on the selected tariff, its conditions and documented bonus activities.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the <highlight>partnership</highlight>
faq.subtitle: Responsibilities, benefits and requirements explained clearly.

items.question: What exactly is the Healio health budget?
items.answer: Depending on their personal situation, patients may be able to combine potential health insurer bonuses with supplementary insurance tariff benefits. This can result in a health budget of up to EUR 3,000 over two years. Healio checks individual eligibility.

items.question: Does the partnership cost my practice anything?
items.answer: Partner practices pay no participation fee. Healio provides information materials and displays free of charge. After the introductory meeting, you decide for yourself whether and where to use the information.

items.question: Do I have to explain or recommend insurance?
items.answer: No. Your role is limited to providing neutral information. Healio handles the individual check, insurance advice, brokerage and application support directly with the interested patient.

items.question: Which services may be reimbursed?
items.answer: Depending on the tariff, benefits may include naturopathy, osteopathy, TCM, chiropractic care, vision aids and dental services. Scope, waiting periods and reimbursement conditions are always determined by the selected tariff.

items.question: Do I have to change my practice concept?
items.answer: No. Treatment, pricing and professional decisions remain entirely with you. Healio only adds a neutral information path for patients who wish to review their funding options.

items.question: How are the vision aid benefits structured?
items.answer: The SDK tariff provides up to EUR 500 for vision aids. Separately, documented activities may generate a freely usable IKK cash bonus that can further reduce the patient's contribution. It is not a flat-rate glasses subsidy.

moral.title: Let's be honest: your patients give you their trust. And their money.
moral.text1: If you know there is a system that can unlock a health budget of up to 3,000 euros for your patients, then informing them is the least you can do. You don't need to do more, Healio takes care of the rest.
moral.text2: Turn it around: your own practitioner knew about such an option and never told you. You would be upset, rightly so. You might not come back, because withholding knowledge that tangibly helps destroys trust.
moral.text3: The effort is minimal, the value for your patients is huge. Everyone should ask themselves: am I giving enough back to my valued patients?
